{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cave of Truth''' was a cave on [[Teya IV]]. It was meant to test a young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] student on their fear, impatience, anger and physical limits. For over 600 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[Willm Lywin]] guarded the cave and brought students to it. [[Vici Ramunee]] made a successful trip through the cave during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] as part of her [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] at the [[Teyan Praxeum]].
